t: You're looking at the Reimann School and Studios, an art academy. It takes its name from Albert Reimann, a German Jewish sculptor and education innovator who lived from 1874 to 1976 and was persecuted by the Nazis. His name is on the school because of his work as an educator, and his story is one of persecution and survival. The material I have is brief, so I'll say no more than that: the school stands as a tribute to him.
